_comment: The rules of TestDataTool seed-legacy (docs/sit-seed.md, "Values from the old system"): a path of a seed case's request (merged over the setup body), and where its value is in the case's Sample Trade as the old system's trade query returns it. A rule is "<from>" or {"from": "<from>", "as": "<conversion>"}. from: a field of the trade (dots between names, a number for an element of a list), or tag:<name>, the value of the trade's tag of that name. as: number, boolean (true/false, Y/N, yes/no) or date:<pattern> (read with the pattern, sent as yyyy-MM-dd); none sends the value as it is. A back-to-back trade (its packageId not its trade ID) gives the values of its package's own trade. Read from the field names of one response: confirm each rule with MO. A field with no rule keeps the catalog's value; the fields still without one are in docs/sit-seed.md, Open.
